mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (id, tenant_code, order_id, biz_type, biz_no, pay_no, pay_method, pay_method_code, amount, status, pay_time, callback_raw, remark, create_time, creator, editor) VALUES (#{record.id}, #{record.tenantCode}, #{record.orderId}, #{record.bizType}, #{record.bizNo}, #{record.payNo}, #{record.payMethod}, #{record.payMethodCode}, #{record.amount}, #{record.status}, #{record.payTime}, #{record.callbackRaw}, #{record.remark}, #{record.createTime}, #{record.creator}, #{record.editor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM payment_record p WHERE

SELECT CAST(p.id AS VARCHAR) AS "id", p.tenant_code AS "tenantCode", CAST(p.order_id AS VARCHAR) AS "orderId", p.biz_type AS "bizType", p.biz_no AS "bizNo", p.pay_no AS "payNo", p.pay_method AS "payMethod", p.pay_method_code AS "payMethodCode", p.amount AS "amount", p.status AS "status", to_char(p.pay_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "payTime", p.remark AS "remark", p.creator AS "creator" FROM payment_record p WHERE ORDER BY p.pay_time DESC NULLS LAST, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 2 AND

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 2), 0) AS "total", COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE status = 2) AS "totalCount", COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND pay_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) AS "month", COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE status = 2 AND pay_time >= CURRENT_DATE), 0) AS "today", COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE biz_type = 1 AND status = 2) AS "orderCount", COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE biz_type = 2 AND status = 2) AS "statementCount" FROM payment_record

SELECT p.pay_method_code AS "payMethodCode", p.pay_method AS "payMethod", COUNT(1) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS "amount" FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 2
AND p.pay_time >= #{from}::date
AND p.pay_time < (#{to}::date + INTERVAL '1 day')
GROUP BY p.pay_method_code, p.pay_method ORDER BY SUM(p.amount) DESC
